name: jwt_decode
description: Decode a JSON Web Token's header and payload without verifying the signature, with a clear warning that it is not verified: alg, kid and typ, the registered claims, iat, nbf and exp as UTC dates and, against a time given in the input (the clock is never read), whether it is expired or not yet valid. Flags alg none, HS/RS algorithm-confusion risk, keys embedded in the header (jwk, jku, x5u, x5c), suspicious kid values and missing exp. JWE tokens show their protected header.

token.description: Compact JWS or JWE; a leading "Bearer " is ignored

now.description: Reference time: Unix seconds or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; without it exp and nbf are not evaluated

leeway.description: Clock skew in seconds allowed for exp and nbf

catalog.source: RFC 7519 (JWT), RFC 7515 (JWS compact serialisation, base64url without padding), RFC 7518 algorithm names and RFC 8725 (JWT Best Current Practices) for the checks
